description: This file contains a collection of autograd.Function test cases implemented as OpInfos for testing autograd support in PyTorch, including custom functions like NumpyCube, NumpyMul, and various vmap and jvp implementations.

classes.name: NumpyCube
classes.description: Custom autograd.Function implementing a cube operation with forward, backward, vmap, and jvp methods.

classes.name: CubeGenVmap
classes.description: Vmap version of cube operation with support for vmap and jvp.

classes.name: NumpyCubeNotComposable
classes.description: Autograd.Function for a non-composable cube operation, with custom backward.

classes.name: NumpyMul
classes.description: Element-wise multiplication with numpy-based forward and backward, supporting vmap and jvp.

classes.name: MulGenVmap
classes.description: Vmap version of multiplication with support for vmap and jvp.

classes.name: NumpyExp_
classes.description: Exponential function with custom backward, supporting vmap and jvp.

classes.name: NumpySort
classes.description: Sorting with argsort, supporting vmap and jvp.

classes.name: SortGenVmap
classes.description: Vmap version of sort with support for vmap and jvp.

classes.name: NumpyTake
classes.description: Tensor indexing with take_along_axis, supporting vmap and jvp.

classes.name: TakeGenVmap
classes.description: Vmap version of take along dim with support for vmap and jvp.

classes.name: Select
classes.description: Tensor element selection with indexing, supporting vmap and jvp.

classes.name: SelectGenVmap
classes.description: Vmap version of select with support for vmap and jvp.

classes.name: ScaleGradGenVmap
classes.description: Vmap autograd function that scales gradients by a fixed factor.

classes.name: ZeroGradientsGenVmap
classes.description: Vmap autograd function that returns large zero tensors for gradients.

classes.name: ForwardHasDefaultArgs
classes.description: Autograd function with default argument for index, supporting vmap and jvp.

methods.name: to_numpy
methods.description: Converts a tensor to a numpy array on CPU.

methods.name: sample_inputs_numpy_cube
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for NumpyCube related tests.

methods.name: sample_inputs_numpy_mul
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for NumpyMul related tests.

methods.name: sample_inputs_numpy_mul_scalar
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for scalar multiplication tests.

methods.name: sample_inputs_numpy_sort
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for sorting tests.

methods.name: sample_inputs_numpy_take
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for take along dim tests.

methods.name: sample_inputs_select
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for select tests.

methods.name: sample_inputs_forward_default_args
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for functions with default args.
